div.head: IV Atr 7.3
div.ab: Et portireue qui falsi huius consentanei fuerint, eiusdem censure digni sint cum falsis monetariis, nisi rex indulgeat eis, uel se possint adlegiare eodem cyrað uel ordalio predicto.
Et portirevae qui falsi huius consentanei fuerint, eiusdem censurae digni sint cum falsis monetariis, nisi rex indulgeat eis vel se possint adlegiare eodem cyrað vel ordalio praedicto.

And town-reeves who have been accessories to such a fraud shall be liable to the same punishment as coiners, unless the king pardon them, or they can clear themselves by a similar oath of nominated jurors, or by the ordeal specified above.

Und Stadtvögte, welche Mitwisser obiger Fälschung sind, seien desselben Strafurtheils mit den Falschmünzern theilhaftig, ausser wenn der König ihrer schonen will, oder sie sich unschuldig erweisen können durch jenen Eid mit [vom Richter] erkorenen Helfern oder durch vorgenanntes Ordal.

And town-reeves who are privy to the above forgery, let them be subject to the same sentence as the false moneyers, unless the king is willing to spare them, or they can prove themselves innocent by that oath with helpers chosen [by the judge] or by the aforesaid ordeal.
